test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

Aditi is __**meticulous** __by nature.
solution: The correct answer is **"careless."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **'meticulous'** means showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise. (ब्‍योरों पर बहुत ध्‍यान देने वाला या ब्‍योरों को बहुत ध्यान से दिखाने वाला; बहुत सतर्क, अति सावधान) • **Example:** *Many hours of **meticulous**__ preparation have gone into writing the book.* • **"Careless"** means not giving sufficient attention or thought to avoid harm or errors. (असावधान, लापरवाह) __ • **Example:** *He is a **careless**__ boy.* • The sentence suggests that Aditi is very careful and precise. • The antonym of **'meticulous'** is **'careless.'** • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Accurate** means exact and correct; without mistakes. (यथार्थ और सही; त्रुटिहीन) • **Precise** means clear and accurate. (स्‍पष्‍ट और सही) • **Concise** means giving a lot of information in a few words; brief. (थोड़े शब्‍दों में काफ़ी सूचना देते हुए; संक्षिप्‍त) 16b:T7be, The **correct answer** is **option 2) BADC.**
